🎬 Simon Says (2026)

A 21st birthday party takes a sinister turn when an unexpected guest joins the celebration and suggests a seemingly innocent game of Simon Says. The friends laugh their way through the first few commands, but the fun quickly disappears when the challenges become dangerous and refusing to play is no longer an option.

As the game grows more unpredictable, the group finds themselves trapped in a terrifying test where every command could change their fate. Desperate to survive, they must navigate mounting fear, broken trust, and shocking surprises while searching for a way to bring the twisted game to an end.

Blending slasher horror with dark comedy and bloody chaos, Simon Says turns a childhood favorite into one unforgettable nightmare. Watch the full movie now on Tubi.
